crossRefs.note: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you…
They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’ ”
But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these…
He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am…
For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among…
For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call…

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
translations.asv: Then saith Jesus unto them, Fear not: go tell my brethren that they depart into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
